summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) announcing results of its annual general meeting held on 21 April 2026. The meeting approved routine items: adoption of annual report, profit carry-forward (no dividend), re-election of board members and chairman, reappointment of auditor, advisory vote on remuneration report, and authorization to acquire treasury shares (up to 10% of share capital) and to increase share capital with and without pre-emptive rights (each up to DKK 70,185,000) expiring 2028. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (no dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a routine governance update with no special-situation catalyst.
